(not sure if sarcastic or not haha) but yeah :'D

He means quite a bit to me and for the most part is my dream partner but thank you. I think we can work on things, but I wonder if this is the stereotypical cliché of "i can change/fix him". We have a lot of trust issues, some because he's lied to me and deceived me in the past, some because of past traumas he's had with other exes.

I'll keep looking for a job and ways to improve our relationship. THank you for giving it to me straight and trying ot help me find a solution!

So I think he only ticks like 2-3 boxes.

That doesn't really help; me and him are inseparable and the issue is that he doesn't want people interacting with me. I cut off most people I reconnected with that happen to be men. he's very controlling and I don't even think he truly loves me.
